answer: To resist Sybil attacks, economic AI agents can stake valuable tokens on predicted channel responses, verifying identity through multi-agent consensus where each "jetty" anchors trust anchors. When suspects emerge, a "violet" distress flag signals others to flood-check, cross-referencing claims across the "river" of network traffic. Attackers must then overproduce costly proof-of-liquidity trials across every agent, making fake identities economically prohibitive.
